examShortTricks: Trick 1: Allotrope names: rhombic (α, octahedral, stable below 96 °C), monoclinic (β, prismatic, 96–119 °C), plastic (γ, amorphous) + milk of sulphur and colloidal sulphur.
Trick 2: Transition temperature 95.6 °C between rhombic and monoclinic — the exact number earns the mark.
Trick 3: Uses in one line each: vulcanisation of rubber, H2SO4 manufacture, gunpowder/matches, fungicides and medicines.
